newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Businessman eyes large stake in Metacorp.
newsitem.headline: Businessman eyes large stake in Metacorp.

text.p: Businessman Azman Firdaus Shafii will emerge as the largest single shareholder in Metacorp Bhd if his proposal to buy a 23.3 percent stake is approved, Malaysian newspapers reported on Monday.

Azman told reporters after Metacorp's annual meeting over the weekend that his private firm Jelang Mutiara Sdn Bhd, plans to buy the stake for 208 million ringgit, or at eight ringgit a share, from infrastructure developer Intria Bhd.
"We are in the midst of signing the sale and purchase agreement and the exercise is expected to be completed in a few months," Azman was quoted as saying in The Star.
He is currently executive vice chairman of Metacorp, a toll road operator and property developer. Azman was formerly director and executive vice chairman of Intria.
Metacorp stock closed Friday trading at 6.30 ringgit, and Intria at 5.10.
